Javokhir Sindarov is playing some of the best chess of his life right now. Winning the Candidates, Olympiad Gold, and now he is the Challenger to Gukesh - they will fight for the World Championship title in just 2 days! Check out this special interview we did with Sindarov on the media day.
Video: ChessBase India
Interview: Himank Ghosh
Shot by: Abhyudaya Ram, Amruta Mokal
Edited by: Tushar Damor
